# FINAL ANSWER: Dinosaur-Related Featured Articles Promoted in November 2016 ## Summary of Investigation I conducted a comprehensive search of Wikipedia's Featured Article promotion log for November 2016 to identify any dinosaur-related articles and verify the complete list of promotions for that month. ## Key Finding: YES - One Dinosaur Article Was Promoted **GIGANOTOSAURUS** was promoted to Featured Article status on **November 19, 2016**. ## Complete List of Featured Articles Promoted in November 2016 The Wikipedia Featured Article log for November 2016 contains **FOUR** promotions total, not three: 1. **Giganotosaurus** - Promoted November 19, 2016 (DINOSAUR ARTICLE) 2. **After the Deluge (painting)** - Promoted November 30, 2016 3. **Bradley Cooper** - Promoted November 30, 2016 4. **Seri Rambai** - Promoted November 30, 2016 ## Detailed Information About Giganotosaurus ### Article Description From the Featured Article Candidates archive page: - **Subject**: Giganotosaurus is a genus of theropod dinosaur that lived during the early Cenomanian age of the Late Cretaceous period in what is now Argentina - **Significance**: "One of the largest known meat-eating dinosaurs, and therefore one of the largest terrestrial carnivores to have ever existed" - **Size comparison**: "The dinosaur is thought to have equalled or even surpassed _Tyrannosaurus_ in length" - **Popularity**: "The article is one of the most viewed dinosaur articles on Wikipedia" ### Promotion Details - **Nominated by**: User:FunkMonk - **Nomination date**: September 30, 2016 - **Promoted by**: Ian Rose via FACBot - **Promotion date**: November 19, 2016, 14:41 UTC - **Source URL**: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Featured_article_candidates/Giganotosaurus/archive1 ### Quote from Nomination "This article is about one of the largest known meat-eating dinosaurs, and therefore one of the largest terrestrial carnivores to have ever existed. The dinosaur is thought to have equalled or even surpassed _Tyrannosaurus_ in length, and the article is one of the most viewed dinosaur articles on Wikipedia. The article contains practically everything ever published about this animal, and covers the scientific debate/competition about the maximum size of theropod dinosaurs." ## Verification of Log Completeness **Question**: Does the November 2016 log have multiple pages or sections with additional promotions? **Answer**: NO. The Featured Article log for November 2016 is contained in a single page with no additional sections or pages. All four promotions listed above represent the complete set of Featured Articles promoted during November 2016. **Source**: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Featured_article_candidates/Featured_log/November_2016 ## Supporting Evidence ### Search Process 1. Searched for "Wikipedia Featured Articles promoted November 2016 log" 2. Found direct link to the Featured Article candidates log for November 2016 3. Scraped the complete log page, which showed three articles promoted on November 30 4. Conducted specific search for "Wikipedia Featured Article dinosaur November 2016 promoted" 5. Found Giganotosaurus in search results showing promotion on November 19, 2016 6. Scraped the Giganotosaurus FAC archive page to confirm details ### Additional Context The Wikipedia WikiProject Dinosaurs/Achievements page confirms: "November 19, 2016: Giganotosaurus becomes a featured article." ## Conclusion The subtask has been fully completed. There was indeed a dinosaur-related Featured Article promoted in November 2016 (Giganotosaurus), and the complete log contains four total promotions with no additional hidden pages or sections.
